source_note: Population estimates are sourced from Nomis mid-year population estimates at LAD level.
Working-age population uses APS LAD counts for people aged 16-64 to align with labour-market rates.
Employment rate uses the APS percentage series for people aged 16-64, with custom-region aggregation reweighted from the source numerators and denominators.
Unemployment rate uses the APS percentage series for people aged 16-64, with custom-region aggregation reweighted from the source numerators and denominators.
Economic activity rate uses the APS percentage series for people aged 16-64, with custom-region aggregation reweighted from the source numerators and denominators.
NVQ4+ share uses the APS RQF percentage series for residents aged 16-64, with custom-region aggregation reweighted from the source numerators and denominators.
No qualifications share uses the APS RQF percentage series for residents aged 16-64, with custom-region aggregation reweighted from the source numerators and denominators.
Professional occupations share uses the APS SOC2020 percentage series for professional occupations, with custom-region aggregation reweighted from the source numerators and denominators.
